notes: v0.16.9 adds a strictly local read_only_batch action behind the existing stable Asympta dispatch(op=call) compatibility path; at most six independent read-only actions, four concurrent, all prevalidated, existing per-action permission/predictive/audit checks, bounded complete results and explicit partial/error reports. No shell, UI mutation, Xcode publishing or network actions in batch. Optional text_mirror=summary is only for structuredContent clients; default full preserves MCP compatibility. Original v0.16.8 live 3 independent calls took 8,531ms. Three seed-based in-process equal-workload A/B sets reduce 31–36 separate logical calls to eight batches and modeled transport bytes by ~52.7–53.8%, with equal exact semantic results. CPU speedup is not claimed. Actual host benefit must be independently measured on deployed v0.16.9. See docs/verification/2026-10-10-v0169-mcp-readonly-batch.md.
